boundary12_in_guard_scope.evidence: planning_semantic_v2 dispatch supplies a structured contract and response_schema; the guard applicability check is response_schema is not None.

predicate_match_triggers_before_parser_s.evidence: ModelGateway attaches output_shape and evaluates the predicate before returning ModelResult; Contract Runtime conversion starts only after that return.

fallback_bypass_path.evidence: Both explicit primary and configured_fallback attempts use dispatch_explicit_model_route and ModelGateway._complete_resolved.

plain_vs_tool_difference.evidence: Boundary 12 execution_mode is plain. Strict-tool extraction occurs after the guard, so plain mode does not bypass the guard; it does affect which normalized tool evidence exists.

normalized_response_type_can_invalidate_.evidence: A missing output_shape, unknown block, text block, tool call, projection change, or incomplete transport makes the exact predicate return false.

finish_reason_mismatch.evidence: normalize_finish_reason maps the observed max_tokens to the accepted predicate value.

whitespace_or_empty_text_can_invalidate.evidence: text_block_count must be zero; an empty or whitespace text block can fail exact reasoning-only even when normalized visible output is zero or non-useful. Raw text block presence was not recorded.

partial_final_text_can_invalidate.evidence: Any text block or provider-visible text makes the exact reasoning-only predicate false; current raw evidence cannot establish whether this occurred.

control_flow: local output-limit terminal reclassification after attempt exhaustion
diagnostic_observer_gap: Provider content-block snapshots are emitted only when the planning-repair diagnostic flag and target context are active. The real Short preflight explicitly kept PA diagnostic flags disabled, and the canonical execution package contains no Boundary 12 provider-shape observation.
